authDeclaredScope: authDeclared on an outbound invocation reports whether the client presents credentials, as declared in source and config: a WCF client credential type, a connection string's authentication, an API key, token or certificate. Credentials added outside the code (a sidecar, a gateway, a delegating handler registered elsewhere) are not visible to static analysis, so none_declared and not_assessed are prompts to review, not findings.
